scope.publication: serial one PUT per commit; compaction adds commits
scope.reopen: new repository instance in the same process
scope.traffic: provider body bytes only; excludes HEAD/LIST response metadata, transport framing and SDK-internal retries
scope.memory: candidate peak_pending_section_bytes is a conservative encoded phase bound; baseline final_pending_section_bytes is residual cache state, not a peak; process RSS includes provider and test driver
scope.audit: section-size audit verifies signed headers outside measured I/O
scope.budgets: 256 MiB metadata at10k; explicit1GiB metadata at100k;64MiB pending throughout all phases; server defaults unchanged
